episodes.title: I'm Here
episodes.summary: Koichi is convinced he'll never manage to become a hero, until he meets someone with an odd take on justice.

episodes.title: Takeoff
episodes.summary: Some people frown upon vigilante activities, but the least they could do is remember The Crawler's name.

episodes.title: Bee
episodes.summary: The drug Trigger is wreaking havoc all over town, but figuring out who's dealing it is easier said than done.

episodes.title: Top Runner
episodes.summary: What happens when pro heroes and vigilantes target the same villain? Is it possible to work as a team?

episodes.title: Judgment
episodes.summary: Koichi and Pop each find themselves considerably influenced by various events from their pasts.

episodes.title: Crossing Lines
episodes.summary: Hachisuka tries manipulating Stendhal into fighting targets of her choosing, but can anyone control him?

episodes.title: Makoto/Truth
episodes.summary: Makoto offers to help a struggling Koichi with his studies, but she requests something surprising in return.

episodes.title: Major
episodes.summary: The American hero Captain Celebrity sets up shop in Japan, and it isn't long before trouble begins.

episodes.title: Mom Descends!
episodes.summary: Koichi's mother is in town, and he's willing to take drastic measures so that she'll let him stay in Tokyo.

episodes.title: Event Announcement!
episodes.summary: Pop receives a request to perform at an upcoming local event, and she finds herself in need of guidance.

episodes.title: The Day Of
episodes.summary: Preparing for Narufest proves to be an uphill battle. Will teamwork be what gets everyone to the finish line?

episodes.title: Goodbye to Dad
episodes.summary: There's trouble when the power goes out at Narufest, all while Knuckleduster fights a very personal battle.

episodes.title: What a Man Takes with Him
episodes.summary: Narufest turned out to be a huge success, but our vigilantes must decide whether it's time for some changes.

episodes.title: Day-Tripping Down to Naniwa!
episodes.summary: Pop gets invited to a mascot-idol event in Osaka, and Koichi accompanies her.

episodes.title: Crabtastic Rampage!
episodes.summary: Koichi and Pop get dragged into an incident when a Trigger dealer unleashes a cast of rampaging robotic crabs!

episodes.title: Public and Private
episodes.summary: Tsukauchi's investigation into the Trigger network has hit a wall, and he turns to All Might for advice.

episodes.title: A Rational Man
episodes.summary: Koichi's in double trouble, facing down a villain who might clobber him, and Eraser Head who might arrest him!

episodes.title: The Man Returns
episodes.summary: Koichi and Pop get into more Trigger trouble, and we learn where Knuckleduster has been.

episodes.title: Rain and Clouds
episodes.summary: Koichi encounters Eraser Head, who reminiscences about his student days.

episodes.title: Glass Sky
episodes.summary: When he was young, Aizawa's inexperience and awkward Quirk forced him to grapple with his self-esteem.

episodes.title: A Sky with No Rain Left
episodes.summary: When Aizawa was a younger, he and his friend Shirakumo were forced into a fight with a giant villain...

episodes.title: Farewell Party
episodes.summary: With his legal problems soon to be taken care of, Captain Celebrity makes plans to return to America.

episodes.title: Zero Hour
episodes.summary: Captain Celebrity's farewell party begins, but the Scarred Man has some unpleasant surprises in store...

episodes.title: Balloon Soul
episodes.summary: Captain Celebrity tries to save the Sky Egg with Koichi's help, while reminiscing on what brought him here.

episodes.title: This is a Hero!!
episodes.summary: The Sky Egg falls as Captain Celebrity hits his limit, with only one person capable of saving the day...
